bullets.text: GPT-5.2 Revolutionizes Enterprise AI - **Microsoft Foundry** introduces GPT-5.2, enhancing reasoning and compliance for enterprise applications.
Windows Terminal Enhanced with Copilot - **GitHub Copilot CLI** now optimizes the Windows Terminal for seamless development experiences.
Personalize Your PC with New Themes - **Microsoft Store** launches a new Themes department, offering over 400 customizable themes.
Azure Storage Innovations Unveiled - **Microsoft** showcases advancements in Azure Storage, enhancing AI model training and deployment.
GPT-5.2 Now in Microsoft 365 - **Microsoft 365 Copilot** integrates GPT-5.2, enhancing strategic insights and everyday tasks.
Cybersecurity Threats from Impersonation - **Microsoft** reveals tactics used by cybercriminals posing as legitimate employees.
AI Integration Demands Security Culture - **Microsoft Ignite 2025** emphasizes building a security-first culture amidst AI advancements.
Transparent Email Security Insights Released - **Microsoft** publishes a new benchmarking report on email security effectiveness.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Update - **Microsoft** announces new features and improvements in the latest Insider Preview Build.
Advancements in Windows PC Gaming - **Microsoft** highlights innovations in handheld gaming and DirectX performance improvements.
